alzendor.name: Alzendor
alzendor.description: The home realm: every kind of weather, and extremes only rarely.

rimewaste.name: the Rimewaste
rimewaste.description: A realm of endless winter: frigid, howling, and snowing almost without pause.

stillsands.name: the Stillsands
stillsands.description: A dead-still desert of glass under a sun that never relents. It never rains.

gullhaven.name: Gullhaven
gullhaven.description: A shipyard town on a grey, gull-loud coast. Your ship has come in to die here.

copperstall.name: Copperstall
copperstall.description: A market town of a thousand stalls, and as many quarrels.

thornwick.name: Thornwick
thornwick.description: A hamlet at the edge of an old, damp wood.

lowwick.name: Low Wick
lowwick.description: A small, damp town that has got too small for you.

reveal.text: Folk around the lake have started telling you about Saltmere Isle, out past the ferry.

tavern.name: The Gilded Tankard
tavern.description: A low-beamed tavern thick with pipe smoke. A fire crackles in the hearth, and a scarred oak bar runs along the back wall. A trapdoor behind the bar leads down, and a side door opens east onto an alley.

features.ground: Worn floorboards, dark with a century of spilled ale.
features.hearth: A wide stone hearth. The fire in it never seems to go out.
features.bar: Scarred oak, polished by a thousand elbows.

flavor.touch:ground: crouches and presses a palm to the worn floorboards.
flavor.touch:hearth: holds a hand to the hearth and pulls it back quickly.
flavor.sit:bar: pulls up a stool at the bar.

cellar.name: Tavern Cellar
cellar.description: A cool, damp cellar stacked with casks. Somewhere water drips steadily onto stone.

features.casks: Oak casks, chalk-marked with dates and the brewer's initials.
features.ground: Packed earth, cold and slightly damp.

flavor.touch:ground: kneels and touches the cold, packed earth.
flavor.touch:casks: raps a knuckle on a cask. It sounds full.

market_square.name: Market Square
market_square.description: Stalls crowd the cobbled square around a mossy fountain. Hawkers shout prices over one another. The tavern lies south, a smithy east, the temple north, the harbor road heads west, and an alley slips away southeast.

features.fountain: A stone fountain carved with leaping fish. Coins glint at the bottom.
features.stalls: Canvas-roofed stalls selling everything from turnips to tin charms.

flavor.touch:fountain: trails their fingers through the cold fountain water.
flavor.sit:fountain: sits on the rim of the fountain.

smithy.name: Brannoc's Smithy
smithy.description: Heat rolls out of the forge in waves. Tools hang in neat rows above a heavy anvil.

features.anvil: A dented iron anvil, still warm from the morning's work.
features.forge: A coal forge glowing a sullen orange.

flavor.touch:anvil: lays a hand on the anvil and snatches it back. Still warm.

temple_steps.name: Temple Steps
temple_steps.description: Broad marble steps climb to the temple doors. A great bronze bell hangs in the archway above. A lane runs north to the city gate.

features.bell: A bronze bell green with age. It rings the hours across the Old Quarter.
features.steps: Marble steps worn into shallow bowls by countless feet.

flavor.touch:bell: reaches up and touches the bell. It hums faintly.
flavor.sit:steps: sits down on the temple steps.

harbor_road.name: Harbor Road
harbor_road.description: A muddy road slopes down toward the water, lined with warehouses and the smell of tar. The market is east; the pier is west and the fish market south.

features.warehouses: Tall timber warehouses, their doors chained shut.

pier.name: The Long Pier
pier.description: Weathered planks stretch out over grey water. Gulls squabble on the pilings, and a lighthouse stands to the north. A shore path leads west, out of the city toward Harrowlake.

features.water: Grey, choppy water that slaps against the pilings.

flavor.touch:water: leans over the edge and dips a hand into the cold sea.
flavor.sit:ropes: sits on a coil of rope, legs dangling over the edge.

fish_market.name: Fish Market
fish_market.description: Slabs of ice glisten under the morning catch. Everything smells of brine.

features.ice: Rough blocks of ice, shipped down from the mountains.

lighthouse.name: Lighthouse Base
lighthouse.description: The whitewashed lighthouse towers overhead. Its door is locked, but the keeper's bench outside is free.

features.bench: A salt-bleached bench facing the sea.

flavor.sit:bench: settles onto the keeper's bench and looks out to sea.

back_alley.name: Back Alley
back_alley.description: A narrow, rubbish-strewn alley behind the tavern. Someone has scratched crude tusks into the brickwork. The smithy's back door is north; the market square opens to the northwest.

features.bricks: Old bricks, scratched with a crude drawing of tusks.

flavor.touch:bricks: runs a hand over the scratched brickwork.

north_gate.name: North Gate
north_gate.description: A squat stone gatehouse marks the edge of Harrowgate. Beyond it, a cart track runs north toward a dark line of trees.

features.gate: Iron-bound oak doors, propped open. Bored guards ignore you.
features.trees: Spiderwood. Nobody goes there without a reason.

flavor.touch:gate: lays a hand on the cold iron bands of the gate.

village_green.name: Village Green
village_green.description: A sloping green at the heart of Harrowlake, ringed by fishing cottages. The lake glitters beyond the rooftops.

features.well: A mossy well with a tin cup on a chain.

flavor.touch:well: leans on the well's mossy rim and peers down.

chapel.name: Lakeside Chapel
chapel.description: A whitewashed chapel with a bell tower and a single stained-glass window showing a ferryman.

features.window: Stained glass: a ferryman poling across a lake of stars.

drowned_lantern.name: The Drowned Lantern
drowned_lantern.description: A smoky inn with nets hung from the rafters and a lantern in a bottle over the door.

features.nets: Old fishing nets, heavy with dust and dried weed.
features.hearth: A peat fire, more smoke than flame.

flavor.touch:hearth: warms their hands over the smoky peat fire.

ferry_dock.name: Ferry Dock
ferry_dock.description: A long jetty juts into the lake. A flat-bottomed ferry is tied up, rocking gently. Far out across the water, a smudge of mist hangs over something.

features.ferry: A broad, flat ferry with a pole and a lantern hook.

woodland_path.name: Woodland Path
woodland_path.description: The cart track dwindles to a path under old oaks. Pale threads drift between the branches overhead.

flavor.touch:threads: brushes a strand of silk. It clings to their fingers.

mossy_clearing.name: Mossy Clearing
mossy_clearing.description: A quiet clearing carpeted in moss. A fallen oak lies across it, hollowed by rot.

features.oak: A fallen oak, soft with rot.

flavor.sit:oak: sits on the fallen oak. It creaks.

trap.name: a poacher's snare
trap.hit: A loop of wire snaps tight around your ankle and yanks you off your feet.
trap.avoid: You spot a poacher's snare among the moss, and step over it.
trap.sprung: {actor} yelps as a snare snaps tight around their ankle!

sign.name: wire
sign.text: A coil of trapper's wire, half-buried in the leaves by the path. Someone sets snares around here.

hunters_camp.name: Hunter's Camp
hunters_camp.description: A lean-to and a ring of stones. Snares and drying pelts hang from the branches.

features.pelts: Fox and hare pelts, drying on a line.

web_tunnel.name: Web Tunnel
web_tunnel.description: The trees close in and the path becomes a tunnel of web. Wrapped bundles hang from the walls, some of them twitching.

features.bundles: Silk-wrapped bundles. You'd rather not know what's inside.

flavor.touch:bundles: pokes a wrapped bundle. It twitches back.

hollow_tree.name: Hollow Tree
hollow_tree.description: The inside of an enormous dead tree, lined with old silk and scattered bones.

silk_cavern.name: Silk Cavern
silk_cavern.description: A vast hollow beneath the roots, its ceiling lost in curtains of silk. Something huge shifts in the dark.

features.silk: Curtains of silk, thick enough to climb.

training_yard.name: Training Yard
training_yard.description: A packed-earth yard behind the smithy, fenced with old spear shafts. Straw dummies and a battered sparring post stand ready for anyone who wants to practise their timing.

features.rack: A rack of blunted practice blades, dented from years of use.

saltmere_landing.name: Saltmere Landing
saltmere_landing.description: A shingle beach where the ferry grounds. Salt crusts every stone, and the mist never quite lifts.

features.shingle: Grey pebbles, rimed white with salt.

salt_flats.name: Salt Flats
salt_flats.description: A white plain of cracked salt stretches into the mist. Your footprints fill slowly with brine.

features.salt: Thick plates of salt, cracked into hexagons.

tide_shrine.name: Tide Shrine
tide_shrine.description: A ring of standing stones, green with weed to the height of a man. Small offerings sit on the altar stone.

features.stones: Each stone is carved with a wave, worn almost smooth.

rime_landing.name: Rime Landing
rime_landing.description: Snow screams sideways across a shelf of black rock. Behind you, a ring of frost marks where the portal opens.

features.ring: A ring of hoarfrost on the rock, humming faintly: the anchor of Veyra's portal.

ice_shelf.name: Ice Shelf
ice_shelf.description: Blue ice groans underfoot. Wolf tracks circle a dark hole in the shelf.

frozen_lake.name: Frozen Lake
frozen_lake.description: A lake frozen so deep the ice is black. Shapes drift beneath it.

howling_pass.name: Howling Pass
howling_pass.description: The wind funnels between two cliffs with a sound like a voice. Something pale moves in the snow.

ember_hollow.name: Ember Hollow
ember_hollow.description: A low cave where someone keeps a fire of black stones burning. The only warmth for miles.

features.fire: Black stones that burn without smoke. Someone feeds them, but you never see who.

rift_chasm.name: Rift Chasm
rift_chasm.description: The pass ends at a chasm. Across it, a tear in the air shows a sky of white heat. It only ever goes one way.

features.rift: A ragged tear in the air. Heat pours out of it, and no one has come back through.

rift_fall.name: Rift Fall
rift_fall.description: You land on glass that burns through your boots. Above, the rift is already closing. There's no way back up.

dune_sea.name: Dune Sea
dune_sea.description: Dunes of fused glass ripple to every horizon, perfectly still. Nothing breathes here.

sun_altar.name: Sun Altar
sun_altar.description: A disc of white stone carved with a sun. A portal frame stands on it, dark and empty, waiting for the air to move.

features.portal: An empty frame of white stone. Carved along it: 'When the still air breathes, and none stand against you, go home.'

switchbacks.name: The Switchbacks
switchbacks.description: The road climbs the mountain in tight switchbacks, the drop beside the wheels a little too close for comfort.

high_pass.name: The High Pass
high_pass.description: Wind howls through the pass between two snow-streaked peaks. The horses lean into it, heads down.

gallows_ridge.name: Gallows Ridge
gallows_ridge.description: The road runs along a bare ridge under a wide sky. An old gibbet creaks beside the road.

harrow_ford.name: The Harrow Ford
harrow_ford.description: The road drops to a wide, stony ford, and cold water rushes around the wheels.

open_lake.name: The Open Lake
open_lake.description: Grey water in every direction. The ferry's lantern sways, and the shore is gone in the mist.

far_shoals.name: The Far Shoals
far_shoals.description: The ferry threads between shoals where the water turns pale and shallow. Osric leans hard on his pole.

cliff_stair.name: Cliff Stair
cliff_stair.description: Steps cut into the cliff climb away from the lighthouse towards the mountains. The sea wind tugs at you.

features.steps: Worn hollow in the middle by centuries of boots.

goat_track.name: Goat Track
goat_track.description: A narrow track, more goat than road, picks along the mountainside. Far above, a carriage road winds into the clouds.

features.road: The High Road, where the coach runs. There is no way up to it from here.

trap.name: a rockfall
trap.hit: Stones clatter down from above, and one catches you square on the shoulder.
trap.avoid: Stones clatter down from above. You throw yourself against the rock face, and they miss you.

sign.name: rubble
sign.text: Fresh rubble lies scattered on the top steps. Something up the track brings stones down.

scree_foot.name: Foot of the Scree
scree_foot.description: Loose stone pours down the mountain into a fan of rubble at your feet. Splintered wood and a broken lantern lie among the rocks, fallen from the road high above.

features.wood: Pieces of a coach door. Someone came down the hard way.
features.scree: Too loose to climb. The only way is down the track.

drift_beach.name: Drift Beach
drift_beach.description: A strip of grey shingle where the lake gives back what it takes: driftwood, rope, a boot. The ferry dock is just along the shore.

features.driftwood: Bleached and smooth. Some of it was a boat once.

wreck_cove.name: Wreck Cove
wreck_cove.description: The ferry lies on its side on the shingle with a hole stove in its planking. Mist hides the lake in every direction. There is no way off this rock but the boat.

features.ferry: The hull is holed below the waterline. A sound plank, something to seal it with, and rope to lash it would see her float again.
features.mist: Thick and white. Somewhere out there, a gull laughs at you.

tide_pools.name: Tide Pools
tide_pools.description: Rock pools full of weed and scuttling things. Driftwood is jammed into every crack.

features.pools: Something with a lot of legs watches you from under the weed.

pine_stand.name: Pine Stand
pine_stand.description: A few wind-bent pines cling to the top of the island. Resin weeps from their bark in golden beads.

features.resin: Sticky and sharp-smelling. Boiled down, it would seal a seam.

castaway_hut.name: Castaway's Hut
castaway_hut.description: A hut of driftwood and sailcloth, smoky and warm. Someone has been here a long time.

slipway.name: The Slipway
slipway.description: Your ship, the Kittiwake, sits propped on timbers on the slipway, her hull sprung from the storm. Hedda the shipwright walks round her, shaking her head. The tar pits are north, the sail loft east, timber stacks west.

features.hull: Planks sprung along the seams. Tar would seal them.
features.kittiwake: Home, for six years. Not for much longer.

tar_pits.name: The Tar Pits
tar_pits.description: Black pools steam and stink. Buckets of tar stand ready by the fire.

features.pools: You would not want to fall in.

timber_stacks.name: Timber Stacks
timber_stacks.description: Stacks of seasoning oak, taller than you. Gulls watch from the top.

features.oak: Good ship timber, years from ready.

sail_loft.name: The Sail Loft
sail_loft.description: Canvas hangs from the rafters. The quay is east.

quay_end.name: Quay End
quay_end.description: The end of the quay, where the trading cogs tie up. The Salted Gull is north; the quay runs east.

features.cogs: Fat-bellied traders, loading for the lake country.

salted_gull.name: The Salted Gull
salted_gull.description: A low tavern that smells of fish stew and wet wool. Old sailors argue about the weather by the fire.

features.fire: The best seat goes to whoever is oldest.

harbourmasters.name: The Harbourmaster's Office
harbourmasters.description: Charts, ledgers, and a window over the whole harbour.

features.charts: The coast, and a cove marked with a skull.

quay_steps.name: Quay Steps
quay_steps.description: Stone steps down to the water. The breakwater runs out to sea to the east.

breakwater_walk.name: The Breakwater
breakwater_walk.description: A long wall of tumbled stone with the sea slapping at both sides. Seal Rocks are east; a lookout post north.

lookout.name: The Lookout
lookout.description: A stone hut at the top of the breakwater, with a view of the whole bay.

features.bay: Down the coast, in a cove, a light flickers where no light should be.

seal_rocks.name: Seal Rocks
seal_rocks.description: Slick black rocks where seals bask and crabs scuttle. A cove opens to the south.

wreckers_cove.name: Wreckers' Cove
wreckers_cove.description: A shingle cove under the cliffs, littered with wreckage. A lantern on a pole swings where it would lure a ship onto the rocks.

gh_open_sea.name: The Open Sea
gh_open_sea.description: The cog rolls out past the breakwater into a grey, heaving sea.

gh_strait.name: The Narrow Strait
gh_strait.description: Cliffs close in on both sides, and the wind funnels between them.

stall_row.name: Stall Row
stall_row.description: Your family's stall stands bare, its awning flapping. Aunt Brisa is waiting with her arms folded. The spice stalls are north, the cloth stalls east, the fountain west.

spice_stalls.name: The Spice Stalls
spice_stalls.description: Sacks of saffron, pepper and cinnamon. Okur the spicer is red in the face.

features.scales: Brass scales. The pans hang a little uneven.

fountain.name: The Fountain
fountain.description: A green copper fountain, with crates stacked against it.

features.fountain: Coins glint in the water. Nobody takes them; it is bad luck.

cloth_stalls.name: The Cloth Stalls
cloth_stalls.description: Bolts of wool and silk. Selene the clothier is shouting at the spicers. Guild Row is east.

features.bolts: Measured by the yard, sold by the ell.

guild_lane.name: Guild Row
guild_lane.description: A street of tall stone houses with brass plates. The guild hall is north, the counting house east, the caravan yard south.

guild_hall.name: The Guild Hall
guild_hall.description: Oak panels and portraits of dead merchants. Guildmaster Thorne sits behind a desk the size of a bed.

features.portraits: Every one of them looks like they are checking your purse.

counting_house.name: The Counting House
counting_house.description: Where the guild's weights and measures are kept. A clerk dozes. The Old Granary is east.

features.weights: Rows of brass weights, all stamped. One shelf is suspiciously dusty.

caravan_yard.name: The Caravan Yard
caravan_yard.description: Wagons and mules, and Dace the caravan master shouting at both.

granary_yard.name: Granary Yard
granary_yard.description: A cobbled yard before the old granary. Something squeaks in the dark below.

granary_cellar.name: Granary Cellar
granary_cellar.description: A low cellar heaped with chewed grain sacks. Eyes glint in the dark.

cs_hill_road.name: The Hill Road
cs_hill_road.description: The caravan creaks up a long hill road between fields.

cs_woods.name: Bandit Woods
cs_woods.description: The road runs through a dark stretch of woods. The guards go quiet.

hunters_lodge.name: The Hunters' Lodge
hunters_lodge.description: Antlers on the walls, a fire in the grate, and your bow by the door. The smokehouse is east; Maud the healer lives north.

healers_hut.name: Maud's Hut
healers_hut.description: Bundles of herbs dry from every beam.

features.herbs: Feverfew, comfrey, and an empty jar labelled MOONBLOOM.

smokehouse.name: The Smokehouse
smokehouse.description: Hams and fish hang in the smoke. Tobin the bargeman is loading timber onto his barge at the jetty. The old wood is east.

wood_edge.name: Edge of the Old Wood
wood_edge.description: Great oaks begin here. Your snare line runs east.

snare_line.name: The Snare Line
snare_line.description: Your snares, along a game trail. Several have been cut. The deep oaks are north; Fernhollow east.

features.snares: Cut, with a knife. Not an animal.

deep_oaks.name: The Deep Oaks
deep_oaks.description: Old trees, and silence. A trail climbs north to Stag's Rise.

trap.name: a poacher's snare
trap.hit: A poacher's snare snaps tight round your ankle.
trap.avoid: You spot a poacher's snare in the leaves and step over it.

sign.name: wire
sign.text: Trapper's wire, not yours, half-buried in the leaves by the trail north. Someone has set snares in the deep oaks.

stags_rise.name: Stag's Rise
stags_rise.description: A bare hill above the trees. Hoofprints, and wolf tracks over them.

fern_bog.name: Fern Bog
fern_bog.description: Ferns taller than you, and black water between them. Something glows faintly ahead.

mist_pool.name: The Mist Pool
mist_pool.description: A still pool where mist gathers. Pale buds float on lily pads, closed tight.

features.buds: Moonbloom. They only open when the air is still and damp.

tw_river_bend.name: The River Bend
tw_river_bend.description: The barge swings round a wide bend, between banks of willow.

tw_rapids.name: The Rapids
tw_rapids.description: White water churns over rocks. Tobin leans on his pole.

gutter_den.name: The Gutter Den
gutter_den.description: A cellar under a bakery where Nan Gristle's gutter kids sleep. It's warm, at least. Tipsy Lane is west, Rat Alley east.

tipsy_lane.name: Tipsy Lane
tipsy_lane.description: A lane behind the tavern, where the drunks end up. One is snoring against the wall, a fat purse at his belt.

features.drunk: Snoring like a saw. He will not notice a thing.

rat_alley.name: Rat Alley
rat_alley.description: A narrow alley that comes out on Wick Square to the east.

wick_square.name: Wick Square
wick_square.description: The town square: the stocks north, the watch house south, and the magistrate's house east.

features.notice: WANTED: anyone who knows anything about anything. The magistrate is not specific.

stocks.name: The Stocks
stocks.description: Two empty stocks, and a rotten cabbage. A reminder.

watch_house.name: The Watch House
watch_house.description: Where the town watch drinks tea and pretends to work.

magistrates_house.name: The Magistrate's House
magistrates_house.description: A fine hall with a fine rug. A guard dog lies across the stairs up to the study (NORTH).

features.stairs: Polished. A thread is stretched across the third step from the top, at ankle height.

magistrates_study.name: The Magistrate's Study
magistrates_study.description: Books, a desk, and a signet ring on a velvet cushion. A window opens onto the rooftops to the east.

trap.name: a tripwire bell
trap.hit: Your foot catches a thread, and a bell clangs somewhere. You fall hard on the top step.
trap.avoid: You step over the thread on the stairs without a sound.
trap.sprung: A bell clangs as {actor} trips on the stairs!

sign.name: thread
sign.text: A thread stretched across a step, at ankle height. It runs up to a bell.

rooftops.name: The Rooftops
rooftops.description: Wet slates and chimney pots. Lanterns move in the streets below: the watch is out. The cart yard is below, to the south.

cart_yard.name: The Cart Yard
cart_yard.description: Carts loading for the city. Joss the carter is tightening a tarpaulin.

lw_low_road.name: The Low Road
lw_low_road.description: The cart rattles out of Low Wick under its tarpaulin. You hold your breath.

lw_tollgate.name: The Tollgate
lw_tollgate.description: Lanterns, and voices. The watch has set up a checkpoint on the road.

lantern-1.name: brass lantern
lantern-1.description: A dented brass lantern. It still has a little oil in it.

map-1.name: worn map
map-1.description: A hand-drawn map of Harrowgate and the roads out of it, stained with ale rings.

horseshoe-1.name: iron horseshoe
horseshoe-1.description: A freshly forged horseshoe. Supposedly lucky.

coin-1.name: copper coin
coin-1.description: A copper coin stamped with a leaping fish.

net-1.name: fishing net
net-1.description: A tangle of knotted net, still damp.

flute-1.name: reed flute
flute-1.description: A simple flute cut from a marsh reed.

token-1.name: ferry token
token-1.description: A bronze token stamped with an oar.

hatchet-1.name: rusty hatchet
hatchet-1.description: A hatchet, rusted but still sharp.

silk-1.name: silk bundle
silk-1.description: A tight bundle of spider silk. Strong as rope.

chart-1.name: sea chart
chart-1.description: A water-stained chart of the lake. Past the ferry crossing, someone has inked a small island and written 'Saltmere'.

glass-1.name: storm glass
glass-1.description: A sealed glass of cloudy water. The crystals in it shift before the weather does: hold it a while and you can read the Rimewaste's skies.

plank-1.name: sound plank
plank-1.description: A length of oak, salt-bleached but sound. Just the size for the hole in the ferry.

pitch-1.name: lump of pitch
pitch-1.description: Pine resin, boiled down to a black, sticky lump.

rope-1.name: coil of rope
rope-1.description: Good hemp rope, salvaged and carefully coiled.

lantern-g.name: false lantern
lantern-g.description: The lantern the wreckers hung to lure ships onto the rocks.

crates-m.name: crates of goods
crates-m.description: Your family's stock: pots, pans and buttons.

weight-m.name: false weight
weight-m.description: A brass weight stamped "one pound". It is light. Someone filed it down.

moonbloom-t.name: moonbloom
moonbloom-t.description: A pale flower that glows faintly.

purse-u.name: fat purse
purse-u.description: A drunk's purse, heavy with coppers.

marta.name: Marta
marta.label: Human Innkeeper
marta.details: Marta runs the Gilded Tankard with a loud laugh and a louder ladle.

brannoc.name: Brannoc
brannoc.label: Dwarf Blacksmith
brannoc.description: soot-streaked and broad as a door
brannoc.details: Brannoc hammers without looking up. His beard is singed at the edges.

orc-1.name: Orc Warrior
orc-1.label: Orc Warrior
orc-1.details: A hulking orc in mismatched plate, knuckles wrapped in leather. It watches you without blinking.

lurker-1.name: Bog Lurker
lurker-1.label: Swamp Creature
lurker-1.details: A hunched shape of mud and weed. Two pale eyes follow every move you make.

attacks.name: grasp
attacks.hit: {actor} drags at {target} with a muddy claw.

lurker-1.hide: {actor} sinks back under the drying reeds.
lurker-1.emerge: {actor} rises out of the rain-soaked reeds.

osric.name: Osric
osric.label: Human Ferryman
osric.details: Osric says nothing. He holds out a hand, palm up, as if waiting for a token.

spider-1.name: Giant Spider
spider-1.label: Arachnid Hunter
spider-1.details: A spider the size of a pony, legs bristling with black hairs. It is very still.
spider-1.hide: {actor} scuttles up into the dark as the wet comes in.
spider-1.emerge: {actor} drops back down on a thread, now the air is dry.

brood-1.name: Broodmother
brood-1.label: Ancient Arachnid
brood-1.details: She fills the far end of the cavern: a bloated, ancient spider, older than the city.

orc-2.name: Orc Whelp
orc-2.label: Young Orc
orc-2.details: A young orc, barely grown into its tusks. It copies the warrior's scowl, badly.

dummy-1.name: Training Dummy
dummy-1.label: Straw and Sackcloth
dummy-1.details: A sack of straw on a pole, with a painted face. It has taken a great many beatings and will take a great many more.

post-1.name: Sparring Post
post-1.label: Oak and Iron
post-1.description: a post with one swinging iron-shod arm
post-1.details: An oak post with a weighted arm that swings back round whenever it's struck. Good for practising with a potion in one slot.

veyra.description: wrapped in furs, eyes white with frost
veyra.details: Veyra keeps the portal anchored, and will send anyone back who asks. 'Most ask sooner than they meant to,' she says.

bram.name: Bram
bram.label: Human Coachman
bram.details: Bram drives the High Road coach over the mountains to Harrowlake and back. 'Three coins, and I'll have you over the pass before your boots are cold. Walk it? Nobody walks it.'

highwayman.name: Highwayman
highwayman.label: Highwayman
highwayman.details: A rider in a dark coat with a scarf pulled up to the eyes.

attacks.name: knife
attacks.hit: {actor} slashes at {target} with a long knife.

ford_wolf.name: Ford Wolf
ford_wolf.label: Grey Wolf
ford_wolf.details: A grey wolf, ribs showing, water streaming from its legs.

ness.name: Old Ness
ness.label: Castaway
ness.details: A woman as weathered as the driftwood, with a laugh like a gull's.

topics.ferry: Holed, is she? You want a plank from the pools, pitch from the pines, and my rope. Take it, take it. Then go and USE the plank ON the ferry.
topics.island: Nine years I've been here. Boats come aground, and the clever ones mend them and go. I like it here.
topics.crabs: Mind the big one in the pools. He's got opinions.

shore_crab.name: Shore Crab
shore_crab.label: Crab
shore_crab.details: A crab the size of a shield, one claw much bigger than the other.

holt.name: Sergeant Holt
holt.label: Trainer
holt.details: A retired soldier who teaches anyone who pays. "Forget what you learned. Ten coins a level, and we start again."

topics.training: Want to unlearn your talents and choose again? RESPEC, here, for ten coins a level.

hedda.name: Hedda
hedda.label: Shipwright
hedda.details: A shipwright with forearms like hawsers and tar to the elbows.

topics.ship: She'll float again, with tar in her seams. But she'll never cross an ocean. Not this season, not ever.
topics.chain: We lost the anchor chain off Seal Rocks in the storm. Bring it back and I can sell it, at least.
topics.lights: Lights in the cove at night. Wreckers. The harbourmaster ought to know.

pell.name: Old Pell
pell.label: Bosun
pell.details: The oldest sailor in Gullhaven, who has never once been wrong about the weather.

topics.rocks: Seal Rocks? Walk out along the breakwater, and mind the crabs. Go when the wind's down: they come out in the spray.
topics.sea: Read the sky before you read the sea, lad. Ask me about the weather.

vane.name: Harbourmaster Vane
vane.label: Harbourmaster
vane.details: A thin man with a precise moustache and a ledger for everything.

topics.wreckers: Wreckers? Bring me proof and I will hang them.

ardith.name: Captain Ardith
ardith.label: Captain
ardith.details: Your captain, who has had the worst week of her life and is trying not to show it.

topics.passage: The Kittiwake's done, and so's my money. I've a berth for you on a cog to the lake country. There's work there for someone who can fight. Go on.

rock_crab.name: Rock Crab
rock_crab.label: Crab
rock_crab.description: a crab the size of a dinner plate
rock_crab.details: A crab the size of a dinner plate.

rock_crab_2.name: Rock Crab
rock_crab_2.label: Crab
rock_crab_2.description: a crab the size of a dinner plate
rock_crab_2.details: A crab the size of a dinner plate.

wrecker.name: Wrecker
wrecker.label: Wrecker

wrecker.details: A scarred man with a boathook.

wrecker_chief.name: Black Annis
wrecker_chief.label: Wrecker Chief

wrecker_chief.details: The wreckers' leader, a cutlass in each hand.

brisa.name: Aunt Brisa
brisa.label: Merchant
brisa.details: Your aunt, who taught you everything about prices and nothing about patience.

topics.stall: Crates. By the fountain. Go. Then USE them ON the stall.
topics.quarrel: Okur and Selene, at it again. The whole market is choosing sides.

okur.name: Okur
okur.label: Spicer
okur.details: A spice merchant who swears his scales are true.

topics.scales: "My scales are true! It is HER scales. Short measure on every ell of silk!"

selene.name: Selene
selene.label: Clothier
selene.details: A clothier who swears her measures are true.

topics.scales: "Short weight on every ounce of saffron in this market! Someone swapped the guild's weights. Look in the counting house, if you don't believe me."

thorne.name: Guildmaster Thorne
thorne.label: Guildmaster
thorne.details: The master of the merchants' guild, who has heard every lie twice.

topics.granary: Rats in the guild granary. Clear them out and I will see you right.

dace.name: Dace
dace.label: Caravan Master
dace.details: A caravan master who has been robbed on every road there is.

topics.passage: Harrowgate? I leave now. Ride guard and the ride is free. Bandits on the hill road, mind.

rat_king.name: Rat King
rat_king.label: Rat King
rat_king.description: a knot of rats, tails tangled, moving as one
rat_king.details: A knot of rats, tails tangled, moving as one.

maud.name: Maud
maud.label: Healer
maud.details: The hamlet's healer, who knows the woods as well as you do.

topics.moonbloom: There's a fever in the hamlet, and moonbloom is the cure. It grows in the mist pool in Fernhollow, and only opens when the air is still and damp. Ask me about the weather, and I'll show you how to tell when.
topics.wood: Someone's been poaching in the deep oaks. Watch your step.

tobin.name: Tobin
tobin.label: Bargeman
tobin.details: A bargeman who takes timber downriver to the big woods.

topics.passage: Downriver? Hop on. The Spiderwood's where the money is, for a hunter.

white_hart.name: White Hart
white_hart.label: Hart
white_hart.description: a pale stag with silver antlers
white_hart.details: A white stag, wary and beautiful. Its hide would make your name.

nan.name: Nan Gristle
nan.label: Gang Boss
nan.details: Nan runs the gutter kids of Low Wick. Nobody knows how old she is. Nobody asks.

topics.work: A purse first. The drunk in Tipsy Lane. Then we talk about real work.
topics.signet: The magistrate's signet ring. With it, I can seal any order I like. Watch the stairs; he's not stupid.

joss.name: Joss
joss.label: Carter
joss.details: A carter who owes Nan a favour and wishes he did not.

topics.passage: Under the tarp. Not a sound till the city. And you never saw me.

watchman.label: Watch
watchman.description: a watchman with a lantern and a club
watchman.details: A watchman with a lantern and a club.

watchman_2.description: a watchman with a lantern and a club
watchman_2.details: A watchman with a lantern and a club.

dagger.name: Dagger
dagger.whiff: your dagger thrust finds only air.
dagger.description: A thin, frost-blued blade that stays keen in the dead cold and the dry.

kick.name: Kick
kick.description: A hard kick. Plain, quick and always there; it likes a neutral day like any weapon.

sword.miss: {actor} swings a sword at {target} and misses.
sword.description: A plain soldier's sword. Steady in any weather, best on a mild day.

draught.name: Healing Draught

draught.whiff: the draught slips through your fingers.
draught.description: A quick sip of something restorative. Indifferent to the sky.

firebolt.name: Firebolt
firebolt.description: A bolt of fire that loves a hot, wild sky and hates the wet.

greataxe.name: Greataxe

greataxe.miss: {actor}'s greataxe thuds into the ground beside {target}.
greataxe.whiff: your greataxe swing comes too slow.
greataxe.description: A heavy axe forged in a winter storm. It sings in a gale.

potion.miss: {actor} fumbles a health potion and spills it.
potion.whiff: you fumble the potion and spill it.
potion.description: A slow, strong healing potion. Indifferent to the sky.

missile.name: Magic Missile
missile.description: A dart of raw force. Like all spells, it's strongest when the air is restless.

mending.name: Mending Light
mending.whiff: the light slips away from you.
mending.description: A gentle spell of healing that draws on rain and a living breeze.

stormcall.name: Stormcall
stormcall.description: A shard of the broodmother's lightning-glass. In a hot, wild downpour it is devastating; anywhere else it does nothing at all.
stormcall.perfect_hit: Lightning answers {actor}, and strikes {target} full on!

rimefang.name: Rimefang
rimefang.description: A blade of ice that never melts, taken from an ice wraith. In a howling blizzard it bites deep; on a mild day it's dull.
rimefang.perfect_hit: {actor}'s Rimefang bites deep into {target}, frost spreading from the wound!

cleave.name: Cleave

cleave.description: A heavy, sweeping blow. The fighter's first lesson.

flick_knife.description: Quick little cuts, over and over.

heavy_swing.description: Slow and brutal. Best in a cold wind.

brace.description: A guard that comes into its own in a gale.

rending_blow.description: Opens a wound that bleeds hard.

rallying_shout.name: Rallying Shout

earthbreaker.description: The ground itself cracks. Needs firm, still ground.

unbroken.miss: {actor} is too slow with an unbreakable guard.
unbroken.description: Nothing gets through. Made for the cold.

frost_shard.name: Frost Shard

frost_shard.description: A shard of ice. Strong in the cold.

mist_veil.description: A guard of mist. Better in the wet.

chain_lightning.description: Spark grown up. Needs a storm.

ice_lance.description: A slow, piercing lance of ice.

smoke_pellet.miss: {actor} is too slow with a cloud of smoke.
smoke_pellet.description: Hard to hit what you can't see. Best in still air.

twin_jab.name: Twin Jab
twin_jab.perfect_hit: {actor} lands a twin jab perfectly on {target}!

garrote.name: Garrote
garrote.description: Slow, quiet and deadly. Best on a still night.

shadowstep.miss: {actor} is too slow with a shadowstep.
shadowstep.description: You aren't where the blow lands.

venom_cloud.description: Poisons hard in hot, still air.

gutter_trick.name: Gutter Trick
gutter_trick.perfect_hit: {actor} lands a gutter trick perfectly on {target}!
gutter_trick.description: Mud in the eyes. Better in the rain.

assassinate.name: Assassinate
assassinate.perfect_hit: {actor} lands an assassin's blade perfectly on {target}!

thousand_cuts.miss: {actor} misses {target} with a flurry of cuts.

thousand_cuts.description: Many small wounds that keep bleeding.

vanishing_act.miss: {actor} is too slow with a vanishing act.

boathook.name: Boathook

sea_biscuits.description: Hard as wood, but they keep you going.

hatchet.name: Hatchet
hatchet.description: A woodsman's axe, good in cool, quiet woods.

skinning_knife.name: Skinning Knife
skinning_knife.perfect_hit: {actor} lands a skinning knife perfectly on {target}!

snare.description: Catches a foot: their next blow comes later.

poultice.perfect_hit: {actor} downs a poultice in one perfect gulp!

pocket_sand.miss: {actor} misses {target} with a fistful of sand.

cosh.name: Cosh
cosh.description: A leather sap full of shot.

stolen_tonic.name: Stolen Tonic
stolen_tonic.perfect_hit: {actor} downs a stolen tonic in one perfect gulp!

harrowfolk.name: The Folk of Harrowgate
harrowfolk.description: Innkeepers, smiths, keepers and ferrymen. They value kindness, manners and safe streets.

rules.note: They're glad of one less orc in the alleys.
A whelp, though? People talk.
Fewer spiders on the north road.
They won't forget a kindness.
Good manners go a long way.
Rudeness gets noticed.

orcs.name: The Back-Alley Orcs
orcs.description: They live by a warrior's code: fight openly, fight well, never run, and never prey on the young.

rules.note: They hate you for it, but a warrior's death is honourable.
A clean killing blow. They respect that.
Killing whelps is a coward's work.
Striking first, before they'd drawn a blade, is beneath a warrior.
You ran.
You were beaten. Weakness.
A warrior's greeting.
Bold. They like bold.

spiders.name: The Spiderwood Brood
spiders.description: Patient hunters. They prize cunning: the strike from hiding, and the wisdom to slip away.

rules.note: The brood admires a hunter who strikes unseen.
The web trembles with hatred.
Swift and precise, as a hunter should be.
Knowing when to slip away is its own cunning.
Caught in the web, like any prey.
Only prey makes so much noise.

boons.note: You move with the brood's patience.

wardens.name: The Wardens of the Wood
wardens.description: Rangers who keep the forest road. They value protecting the wood, and a light step in it.

rules.note: The forest road is safer for it.
A friend of the wardens.
A friendly nod in the woods.

boons.note: The wardens have taught you to weather the wood.

woodcraft.name: Woodcraft
woodcraft.description: You can make camp anywhere in a forest: forests are safe places for you to rest.

shore_sleeper.name: Shore-sleeper
shore_sleeper.description: You can bed down in any sheltered spot on the coast: the shore is a safe place for you to rest.

second_wind.name: Second Wind
second_wind.description: Each time the attuned slot's ball touches the left edge, you heal 1.

last_stand.name: Last Stand
last_stand.description: Below a quarter of your health, everything you use is 20% stronger.

trapsense.name: Trapsense
trapsense.description: You sense traps in the rooms next to you, and they're marked on your map.

steady_hands.name: Steady Hands
steady_hands.description: Your first miss in each fight doesn't use up the beat.

long_breath.name: Long Breath
long_breath.description: A perfect hit widens your other slots' windows for their next beat.

starsight.name: Starsight
starsight.description: You see at night as well as by day.

feather_step.name: Feather Step
feather_step.description: Rough ground slows you no more than open country.

skyreading.name: Skyreading
skyreading.description: You sense which way the weather is heading, about 10 minutes ahead, in any realm.

moonlit_edge.name: Moonlit Edge
moonlit_edge.description: At night, each time the attuned slot's ball touches the right edge, its next hit is 10% stronger (up to 30%).

bloodrhythm.name: Bloodrhythm
bloodrhythm.description: Each miss on the attuned slot makes its next hit 10% stronger (up to 30%).

berserk_seal.name: Berserk Seal
berserk_seal.description: The attuned slot is 50% stronger, but once its ball touches the left edge it is sealed until the fight ends.

thick_hide.name: Thick Hide
thick_hide.description: Weather penalties to your gear are halved.

hunters_nose.name: Hunter's Nose
hunters_nose.description: You smell creatures in the rooms next to you.

texts: The temple bell tolls the hour across the Old Quarter.
A ship's bell clangs somewhere out on the water.
Gulls wheel and scream over the harbor.
A heron cries somewhere out on the water.
Something skitters through the canopy overhead.
A web somewhere nearby thrums, as if plucked.
Somewhere out on the water, a bell rings once.
Far off, something vast moves under the ice, and the ground shudders.

coach-to-harrowlake.name: the High Road coach
coach-to-harrowlake.depart: You pay Bram three coins and climb into the coach. He cracks the whip.
coach-to-harrowlake.leave: {actor} climbs into Bram's coach, and it rattles off towards the mountains.
coach-to-harrowlake.arrive: Bram's coach rattles up, and {actor} climbs down.

coach-to-harrowgate.name: the High Road coach
coach-to-harrowgate.depart: You drop three coins in the coachman's box and climb aboard.
coach-to-harrowgate.leave: {actor} climbs into the coach, and it rattles off towards the mountains.
coach-to-harrowgate.arrive: The High Road coach rattles into the square, and {actor} climbs down.

ferry-to-saltmere.name: the Saltmere ferry
ferry-to-saltmere.closed: Osric shakes his head at the water. He won't take the ferry out in a wind like this.
ferry-to-saltmere.depart: You press five coins into Osric's hand. He pushes off without a word.
ferry-to-saltmere.leave: {actor} boards Osric's ferry, and it slides out into the mist.
ferry-to-saltmere.arrive: The ferry grounds on the shingle, and {actor} steps ashore.

ferry-from-saltmere.name: the Saltmere ferry
ferry-from-saltmere.closed: The ferry waits at the shingle, but nobody will cross in this wind.
ferry-from-saltmere.depart: You ring the bell on its post and drop five coins in the box. The ferry comes for you out of the mist.
ferry-from-saltmere.leave: {actor} boards the ferry, and it slides off into the mist.
ferry-from-saltmere.arrive: The ferry bumps against the jetty, and {actor} steps off.

portal-to-rimewaste.name: Sister Ilse's ring of frost
portal-to-rimewaste.depart: Sister Ilse traces a ring of frost in the air, and it opens onto a howling white world.
portal-to-rimewaste.leave: {actor} steps through Sister Ilse's ring of frost and is gone.
portal-to-rimewaste.arrive: {actor} stumbles out of a ring of frost into the snow.

portal-home.name: Veyra's portal
portal-home.depart: Veyra touches the frost ring, and the Harrowlake chapel shimmers into view.
portal-home.leave: {actor} steps through Veyra's portal and is gone.
portal-home.arrive: {actor} steps out of a ring of frost, shaking off snow.

rift.name: the rift
rift.depart: You step into the heat pouring out of the rift.
rift.leave: {actor} steps into the rift and is gone.
rift.arrive: {actor} tumbles out of the sky onto the hot glass.

sun-portal.name: the Sun Altar portal
sun-portal.closed: The portal frame stays dark. It needs the still air to stir, and no wraiths standing in your way.
sun-portal.depart: The frame fills with a hot wind, and you step into it.
sun-portal.leave: {actor} steps through the portal in a gust of hot wind.
sun-portal.arrive: {actor} staggers out of a gust of hot wind onto the temple steps, skin burnt red.

gullhaven-cog.name: the trading cog
gullhaven-cog.depart: You shoulder your sea bag and climb aboard the cog. Gullhaven shrinks behind you.
gullhaven-cog.arrive: A trading cog ties up, and {actor} steps ashore with a sea bag.

copperstall-caravan.name: Dace's caravan
copperstall-caravan.depart: You climb up beside Dace, and the caravan rolls out of Copperstall.
copperstall-caravan.arrive: Dace's caravan rolls into the square, and {actor} jumps down.

thornwick-barge.name: Tobin's barge
thornwick-barge.depart: You climb onto the timber, and Tobin poles off downriver.
thornwick-barge.arrive: {actor} climbs off a timber barge at the river bank and walks up into the wood.

lowwick-cart.name: Joss's cart
lowwick-cart.depart: You curl up under the tarpaulin among the turnips, and the cart jolts off.
lowwick-cart.arrive: {actor} rolls out from under a tarpaulin in the back alley, and the cart is gone.

rut.text: The coach lurches and stops. A wheel is sunk to the hub in mud, and the driver swears at it.

success.text: With a heave and a sucking sound, the wheel comes free. The driver claps you on the back.

reputation.note: Word gets round that you put your shoulder to a stuck wheel.

failure.text: Your boots slide out from under you, and the wheel rolls back over your foot.

success.text: You wait while the driver digs. It takes a long time.

toll.text: A toll-keeper with a lantern and a bored expression steps into the road. "Two coins a head for the bridge."

success.text: He bites one coin, pockets both, and waves you on.
By the time you have finished explaining, he is apologising to you.

failure.text: He listens politely, then charges you three for wasting his evening.

choices.label: Press a clipped coin into his hand

success.text: He never looks at it. Old tricks are the best ones.

choices.label: Refuse, and let the driver argue

success.text: The argument goes on, and on.

pickpocket.text: The passenger beside you leans in closer than the jolting road explains. A hand brushes your belt.

success.text: You catch them in the act. They drop your purse, and a few of their own coins with it, and flee at the next stop.

reputation.note: The other passengers cheer the thief off the road.

failure.text: You grab at empty air. By the time you check your purse, it is lighter.

choices.label: Shift away and keep a hand on your purse

success.text: They give up and pretend to sleep.

innkeeper.text: A young man opposite you clears his throat. "You came from Harrowgate? The innkeeper at the Gilded Tankard was so kind to me, and I never caught her name. I owe her a letter. Do you remember it?"

success.text: "Marta! Of course." He beams, and insists you share his lunch.
"Martha? I could have sworn it was something else." He writes it down anyway, frowning.
He sighs, and looks out of the window for the rest of the way.

riddle.text: On the still water, the ferry drifts past a rowboat with no oars. An old man in it smiles at you. "Answer me this, and I will tell you something worth knowing. I have cities but no houses, forests but no trees, and water but no fish. What am I?"

success.text: "A map." He nods slowly. "Then here is something for yours: past the burning glass there is a stillness that never ends." The mist takes his boat.
"A pretty answer, and a wrong one." He lets the mist take him.
He shakes his head, smiling, and the mist takes him.
The rowboat drifts away into the mist.

lame_horse.text: One of the horses stumbles and starts to limp. The driver pulls up, cursing.

success.text: A stone, wedged in the shoe. You pry it out, and the horse steps easy again.

failure.text: You can't see anything wrong, and the horse nearly takes your hand off.

choices.label: Wait for the driver to deal with it

success.text: It takes him a while.

fallen_tree.text: The wind has brought a tree down across the road. The driver looks at it, then at you.

success.text: Between you, the tree rolls off the road.

failure.text: A branch whips back and opens your cheek.

success.text: He saws, slowly.

saltmere_rumour.text: Two passengers are arguing about an island. "Saltmere's real, I tell you. Osric the ferryman goes out to it, if he likes you."

success.text: You sleep through the rest of it.

rimewaste_rumour.text: A traveller with frost-blackened fingers sits wrapped in three cloaks. "Been through the ring at Harrowlake chapel," she says to nobody. "Never again."

success.text: "White. Howling. Wolves." She shivers. "Sister Ilse will open it for you, if you're fool enough."
She stares out of the window.

fish.text: A fat silver fish leaps out of the calm water and lands flapping on the deck at your feet.

success.text: You pin it. Osric grills it over his lantern, and it is the best thing you have eaten in days.

failure.text: It flips over the side, and Osric laughs at you.

success.text: It flops back into the lake.

squall.text: A squall comes across the water like a wall. The ferry heels, and spray sheets over the side.

choices.label: Read the gusts and take the pole

success.text: You feel the gusts before they come, and drive the ferry through them. Osric gives you a long look of respect.

reputation.note: Osric tells the dock you can handle a boat.

success.text: You bail until your arms burn, and the ferry rides it out.

failure.text: A wave knocks you into the gunwale.

success.text: You cling on, soaked and frozen, while it passes.

swamped.text: The gale throws the ferry onto its side. Water pours in over the gunwale, and Osric shouts something the wind tears away.

success.text: Somehow, between you, you keep her afloat. You reach the shore half-drowned.

failure.death: The ferry rolls over. The cold takes your breath, then everything else. The lake keeps you.

success.strand: You swim until there is nothing left, and drag yourself up onto shingle you don't know.

failure.death: The water is too cold and the shore too far. The lake keeps you.

success.strand: You cling to a broken plank all night. In the grey morning, the lake gives you back to a shingle beach.

rockslide.text: A roar from above: rocks pour down the mountainside onto the road, and the coach skids towards the edge.

success.text: You land rolling on the road as the rocks thunder past. The coach is still there, just.

failure.strand: You jump the wrong way. The world tumbles, rock and sky and rock, all the way down the scree.

success.text: The coach shudders to a stop on the very lip of the drop.

failure.text: You are thrown about like a die in a cup.

wolves.text: Grey shapes come splashing across the ford in the half-light. Wolves, and they are hungry. The horses scream.

success.text: The coach lurches up the bank, and the wolves fall behind.

failure.text: A wheel catches on a rock. The wolves are on you.

highwaymen.text: Two riders burst from the dark and seize the lead horses. "Stand and deliver!"

success.text: They take it, tip their hats, and are gone into the night.

choices.label: Call out the one you know from the gutters

success.text: "Weasel? Is that you?" A long pause. "...On your way, then." They melt back into the dark.

flask.text: An old woman across from you unscrews a dented flask and holds it out. "Keeps the cold off."

success.text: It burns all the way down, then glows.
"Suit yourself," she says, and has your share.

aground.text: There's a grinding crunch, and the ferry stops dead. In the mist you've run onto rocks, and water is coming in. Osric swears quietly and steers for a shape of an island.

choices.label: Help Osric push off the rocks

success.text: You throw your weight against the pole, and the ferry grinds free. She leaks, but she floats.

failure.text: The pole snaps. There's nothing for it but the island.

cog_squall.text: A squall hits the cog in the strait. The sail cracks like a gunshot, and the helmsman is struggling.

choices.label: Take the helm and read the gusts

success.text: You feel each gust before it comes and ride them through. The captain gives you a long look, then a nod.
The sail comes under control.

failure.text: The rope burns through your hands.

success.text: You cling to the rail until it passes, soaked through.

caravan_bandits.text: In the woods, a rider bursts from the trees and grabs the lead mule. "Your money or your life!"

success.text: You talk money until he is sure he is robbing you, and leaves with a bag of buttons.
He bites a coin and is gone.

barge_snag.text: The barge grinds onto a snag at the rapids and swings sideways. Tobin swears.

choices.label: Read the current and point Tobin to the channel

success.text: You know this river. "Left of the white rock!" The barge slides free.

choices.label: Lever it off with a pole

success.text: It comes free with a lurch.

failure.text: The pole slips and you go in up to your waist.

success.text: It takes him a while.

checkpoint.text: The cart stops at the checkpoint. Boots crunch closer. A lantern lifts the edge of the tarpaulin.

success.text: The lantern passes over you. "Just turnips." The cart rolls on.

failure.text: A boot prods you. You bribe him with everything in your pocket before he can shout.

success.text: A long silence. The tarpaulin drops. "...Move along."

gather.goal: Find a sound plank, a lump of pitch and a coil of rope to mend the ferry.

mend.goal: Mend the ferry: USE PLANK ON FERRY in Wreck Cove.

effects.text: You lash the plank over the hole and seal it with pitch. Osric pushes the ferry off the shingle, and she floats. Old Ness waves you off from the rocks.

tar.goal: Hedda needs tar for the hull. Go NORTH to the tar pits and GET TAR.

caulk.goal: Back on the slipway (SOUTH), seal the hull: USE TAR ON HULL.

effects.text: You work the tar into the sprung seams. Hedda nods: "Good. Now, about my anchor chain..."

ask.goal: The anchor chain went over at Seal Rocks. Old Pell, in the Salted Gull (EAST, then NORTH), knows the way: ASK PELL ABOUT ROCKS. Ask him about the WEATHER too.

chain.goal: Walk out along the breakwater (east of the Quay Steps) to Seal Rocks and GET CHAIN. Crabs bite: press 4, 3 or 2 to use your slots on whatever you target (Tab).

return.goal: Bring the chain back to Hedda on the slipway: USE CHAIN ON HEDDA.

effects.text: Hedda hefts the chain. "That'll pay for the tar. Listen: I've seen lights down in the cove at night."

fight.goal: False lights in Wreckers' Cove, south of Seal Rocks. Deal with the wreckers' leader.

proof.goal: GET the false lantern from the cove and show the harbourmaster: USE LANTERN ON VANE.

effects.text: Vane turns the lantern over. "Proof. Good. You've done this town a service." He counts out a reward.

ask.goal: Captain Ardith is waiting at Quay End. ASK ARDITH ABOUT PASSAGE.

crates.goal: Aunt Brisa wants your goods out. Go WEST to the fountain and GET CRATES.

stall.goal: Back at Stall Row (EAST), set them out: USE CRATES ON STALL.

effects.text: Your stall is open. Within a minute, the shouting starts across the market.

okur.goal: The spicers and clothiers accuse each other of crooked scales. Hear Okur out, NORTH: ASK OKUR ABOUT SCALES.

selene.goal: Now hear Selene, at the cloth stalls: ASK SELENE ABOUT SCALES.

search.goal: Someone swapped the guild's weights. Search the counting house on Guild Row (LOOK at things) and GET what's wrong.

show.goal: Show the guildmaster, in the guild hall: USE WEIGHT ON THORNE.

effects.text: Thorne weighs it in his palm. "Filed. Both of them have been cheating with the guild's own weights." The quarrel ends in two fines.

king.goal: Thorne wants the guild granary cleared: east of the counting house, then DOWN. Kill the Rat King.

effects.text: The squeaking stops. The granary is quiet.

ask.goal: Your aunt can run the stall. You want more. Dace, in the caravan yard south of Guild Row, leaves for Harrowgate: ASK DACE ABOUT PASSAGE.

walk.goal: Walk your snare line: EAST to the smokehouse, EAST into the old wood, and EAST again.

poacher.goal: Your snares are cut, and there's someone else's wire about (LOOK at it: INSPECT WIRE). The poacher has been in the deep oaks, NORTH. Step carefully: CREEP NORTH.

effects.text: Poachers, and their snares. Your own woods are not safe any more.

ask.goal: Maud the healer (back at the hamlet, NORTH of the lodge) wants something: ASK MAUD ABOUT MOONBLOOM.

weather.goal: Learn to read the sky: ASK MAUD ABOUT WEATHER. Then type WEATHER to see when it will be still and damp.

bloom.goal: Be at the mist pool in Fernhollow (east of the snare line) while the air is still and damp, and the moonbloom will open. Bog wisps guard the way.

effects.text: In the stillness, a moonbloom opens, and you pick it.

deliver.goal: Take the moonbloom to Maud: USE MOONBLOOM ON MAUD.

effects.text: Maud brews it at once. "The fever will break by morning. Now, there's talk of a white hart on Stag's Rise..."

hunt.goal: Hunt the white hart on Stag's Rise, NORTH of the deep oaks. The wolves are hunting it too.

effects.text: The white hart falls. Its hide would fetch a fortune in the city.

ask.goal: Sell the hide in the big woods. Tobin, at the smokehouse, takes his barge downriver: ASK TOBIN ABOUT PASSAGE.

purse.goal: Nan wants a purse. The drunk in Tipsy Lane (WEST) won't notice: GET PURSE.

nan.goal: Back to the den (EAST): USE PURSE ON NAN.

effects.text: Nan weighs it, and smiles with all four teeth. "Good. Now, real work: ASK me about the SIGNET."

steal.goal: Steal the magistrate's signet. His house is east of Wick Square, the study up the stairs (NORTH). Deal with the dog, and LOOK at the stairs before you climb.

back.goal: Get the signet back to Nan in the den: USE SIGNET ON NAN.

effects.text: Nan pockets it. Then the bells start. "The watch. They know it was one of mine. You need to be gone, tonight."

roofs.goal: The watch is in the streets. Go over the rooftops (through the magistrate's study, EAST) and down to the cart yard.

joss.goal: Joss the carter owes Nan a favour: ASK JOSS ABOUT PASSAGE.

fighter.name: Fighter
fighter.description: Steel, guard and stubbornness. Fighters wear down anything in front of them.

mage.name: Mage
mage.description: Spells that ride the weather. A mage reads the sky and strikes when it suits them.

rogue.name: Rogue
rogue.description: Quick blades and dirty tricks. Rogues win by never being where the blow lands.

human.name: Human
human.description: Adaptable, talkative, everywhere. Humans get on with people.

elf.name: Elf
elf.description: Long-lived and sharp-eyed, at home under trees and stars.

orc.name: Orc
orc.description: Strong, hardy and proud. Orcs fight with their blood up.

sailor.name: Sailor
sailor.description: You grew up on decks and docks. You read water, wind and knots.
sailor.intro: The storm nearly drowned you all. Now your ship, the Kittiwake, sits on the slipway at Gullhaven with her hull sprung, and Hedda the shipwright says she'll never cross an ocean again. Your old life is ending. Hedda needs a hand first, though. (Your quest is in the Quests panel. Type LOOK to look around, and move with NORTH, SOUTH, EAST and WEST.)

merchant.name: Merchant
merchant.description: You were raised behind a market stall. You know prices, people and lies.
merchant.intro: Your first day running the family stall in Copperstall Market, alone. Aunt Brisa is watching, the market is loud, and across the square two merchants are about to come to blows. (Your quest is in the Quests panel. Type LOOK to look around, and move with NORTH, SOUTH, EAST and WEST.)

woodsman.name: Woodsman
woodsman.description: You lived off the woods: tracking, trapping, and reading the weather on the trail.
woodsman.intro: Your last season in Thornwick. The game is thin, the old wood is quiet, and this morning you found your snares cut. (Your quest is in the Quests panel. Type LOOK to look around, and move with NORTH, SOUTH, EAST and WEST.)

street_urchin.name: Street Urchin
street_urchin.description: You grew up in the gutters. You know locks, crowds and how to run.
street_urchin.intro: Low Wick is a small town, and you've run out of pockets to pick in it. Nan Gristle, who runs the gutter kids, has a job for you. One more, she says. (Your quest is in the Quests panel. Type LOOK to look around, and move with NORTH, SOUTH, EAST and WEST.)
